actionable_steps.citation: Educare Is True Education — SSS Vol 34 (2001), 2001-11-20
actionable_steps.step: Concentrate the mind rather than collect facts — true education is concentration, not information.

actionable_steps.citation: Human Values and Education — SSS Vol 32 (1999), 1999-07-26
actionable_steps.step: Strive to be good, not great — goodness lasts, greatness is temporary.
Practice restraint in speech — excessive talk destroys self-control and good qualities.

actionable_steps.citation: Character - The True End Of Education — SSS Vol 35 (2002), 2002-11-20
actionable_steps.step: Harmonise your secular learning with spiritual education — both, not just degrees for a living.

actionable_steps.citation: Sanctify Your Life By Chanting Gayatri Mantra — SSS Vol 33 (2000), 2000-02-10
actionable_steps.step: Start early, drive slowly, reach safely — turn to God from childhood, not only after retirement.

actionable_steps.citation: The educational crisis and the way out — SSS Vol 30 (1997), 1997-11-22
actionable_steps.step: Wear humility as the hallmark of learning — true education shows itself as respect for humanness.

definition.citation: Educare Is True Education — SSS Vol 34 (2001), 2001-11-20
definition.quote: Education is for life and not for living. Today's education is aimed at merely eking out a livelihood.

discourses.citation: Educare Is True Education — SSS Vol 34 (2001), 2001-11-20
discourses.quote: The essence of education is the concentration of the mind and not the collection of facts. Mere collection of facts will not serve any purpose.

discourses.citation: Character - The True End Of Education — SSS Vol 35 (2002), 2002-11-20
discourses.quote: True education is that which is suffused with truth and love. Without truth, love is ineffective and devoid of value.

discourses.citation: Truth and righteousness are the foundation for true education — SSS Vol 38 (2005), 2005-11-22
discourses.quote: There must be unity between one's inner feelings and outward actions. The harmony between thought, word, and deed is of utmost importance.
Education means broadening the heart. It implies development of control over the senses. It should make one seek to promote the good of the world.

make_it_real: Real education is what you bring out of yourself, not what you put in — live that today.
title: Education

vahinis.quote: The term vidya is derived by adding ya to the root vidh. Ya means 'what'; vidh, 'light'. So, 'that which gives light' is vidya... it is evident that only knowledge of Brahman (Brahma-vidya) deserves to be known as real knowledge.

Spiritual education is, in reality, experience of the truth, awareness of the truth. Pleasing oratory should not be mistaken as experiencing the Truth, which comes about only in the innermost tabernacle of the Self.
